macos.isolation: Guarded hosted macos-15 runner; test-owned active windows; background-only driver; native HID keys with foreground ownership checked before delivery
macos.event_storage: Complete native event sequence retained once per profile; duplicate prefix arrays omitted from intermediate snapshots

windows.failure: English native scenario passed, but input-context cleanup blocked before client exit and before Japanese/Chinese UI profiles. Native Henkan conversion was used. This does not qualify Windows IME.
windows.followup: Capture blocked UI-thread stack and own-process minidump on the isolated runner; no forced exit is counted as acceptance.

shutdown_diagnosis.followup: Use normal focus/window destruction for FORPROCESS input-context ownership; do not activate another profile while shutting down. Natural process exit is still required.

composition_profile_followup.failure: Phrase prediction finalized Hiragana during typing, before candidate conversion and before shutdown could be exercised. No scenario is accepted from this run.
composition_profile_followup.followup: Activate TSF only on the GUI thread, with IME_SMODE_NONE rather than phrase prediction. Actual mode, native input events and natural client exit remain checked.

ordinary_mode_diagnostic.finding: IME_SMODE_NONE produces direct per-character Hiragana commits on this installed MS-IME; candidate conversion and shutdown were not reached.
ordinary_mode_diagnostic.followup: Request IME_SMODE_PLAURALCLAUSE, retain the initial/actual modes, and require candidate conversion plus natural exit. The IME-only dispatch skips unrelated P4 regression; normal push/PR remains unchanged.

multi_clause_followup.failure: No startup status was published; native input and shutdown scenarios did not run. The generated client log was empty.
multi_clause_followup.followup: Arm own-process stack/minidump diagnostics around QApplication initialization, before native input activation.
